about: r2 was closed, but a stray write removed its link line. The Edit guard raises close-invalid only. The log gives the reason 'it had no link line under it', then 'The request is open again.' act puts the request line back to its snapshot text and removes the link line, so the note matches its snapshot except r1's close; the second check is clean. r1 passed cleanly and goes under Done. Reading: an undone close is listed under Closes undone only, not also under Requests still open, whose reasons are failed, no findings, or the outcomes file refused.
